pinned_model.sha256_provenance: recorded from HF's LFS x-linked-etag for the pinned revision AND reproduced from the real downloaded bytes (sha256sum + scripts/fetch_model.mjs) — see docs/evidence/S3/model-manifest.json

storage_backend_decision.summary: The model cache uses OPFS where it works and Cache Storage where OPFS is broken, selected at runtime by a real 4 KiB write probe (src/model/store.ts). Both are plan-sanctioned ("Cache Storage or OPFS").

measurements.chromium_cache_storage_put_397MB: FAILS: "UnknownError: Failed to execute 'put' on 'Cache': Unexpected internal error." (headless Chromium 159) — the original single-backend design could not work here
measurements.chromium_opfs_streaming: WORKS: stream chunks to a temp file while hashing (constant memory), promote temp -> <sha>.gguf after verification; download+write 5.0 s, promote 2.1 s, read-back 396,705,472 bytes, purge works
measurements.webkit_opfs_async_writable: BROKEN in this build at EVERY size (4 KiB .. 32 MiB): "The operation failed for an unknown transient reason" — hence the runtime probe
measurements.webkit_cache_storage_put_397MB: WORKS: 396,705,472 bytes stored in ~8.1 s (quota 1 GiB, usage 438 MiB)
measurements.webkit_full_buffer_paths: assembling the whole 397 MiB in JS memory (chunks+blob+arrayBuffer ~1.2 GiB) OOMs the WebKit renderer — the manager streams chunks into the temp instead and never materializes the full file in JS

sha256_implementation.choice: hand-written incremental SHA-256 (src/model/sha256.ts), differential-tested against node:crypto on canonical vectors, block boundaries, random splits and ~1 MiB buffers

rejected_alternatives.crypto.subtle.digest: only digests COMPLETE buffers — useless for hashing while a resumable download streams; also forces the whole 397 MiB into JS memory on WebKit (measured OOM)

sha256_implementation.measured_throughput: ~23 MB/s single-threaded on this host (64 MiB probe) — the download is hash-bound on fast links (~17 s for the pinned file); the hash runs between chunk reads so the UI keeps painting (manager yields to the renderer every ~250 ms)

test_infra.serve_model: scripts/serve_model.mjs — real pinned file + /model-slow (paced ~100 ms per 8 MiB), /model-wrong-hash (one byte flipped), /model-truncated (honest half-size body), /model-kill-fresh (paced destroy at ~25% so the client holds a non-zero offset, resumed Range requests served), /model-404; every request logged with its Range header
test_infra.test_only_overrides: ?testModelUrl= and ?testProbe=unsupported exist ONLY in test builds (POSTCLIP_TEST_BUILD=1 npm run build); the production build inlines __POSTCLIP_TEST_BUILD__=false and the bundler eliminates the branches (A29; verified by the S5 bundle inspection)

no_new_npm_dependencies: S3 adds ZERO npm dependencies — the state machine, streaming sha256, download/resume logic, storage backends and the local model server are hand-built on platform APIs
